spec.workflowSummary: Small internal admissions lead tracker for a manual WhatsApp + spreadsheet workflow. MVP stores the same lead columns visible in the Admissions Leads Sheet, lets staff update admission/qualification/payment/follow-up fields after WhatsApp conversations, and provides copyable WhatsApp message templates. No WhatsApp API or automated messaging is included.

sourceEvidence.observation: WhatsApp Web is open with an admissions/contact conversation and multiple outgoing green messages/attachments, indicating lead follow-up is handled manually in WhatsApp.
WhatsApp Web remains the active communication tool; the user is reviewing or continuing a lead conversation.
A spreadsheet titled “Admissions Leads Sheet” shows columns: Lead name, Phone, Course, Age, Status, Lead label, Payment, Follow-up, and Last message.

The sheet displays status-like values including Current, Reserved, Waiting; lead labels such as New Lead, Interested, Hot Lead; payment values Pending and Paid; and follow-up examples like Tomorrow 11am and Friday 2pm.
The sheet includes an Export CSV button, supporting a simple export requirement for the leads table.

steps.title: Review admissions leads
steps.input: Existing leads with name, phone, course, age, status, label, payment, follow-up, and last message.
steps.output: A prioritized lead to contact or update.

steps.title: Contact lead manually in WhatsApp
steps.input: Lead phone number, course, last message, and the appropriate template text.
steps.output: A WhatsApp message sent manually by staff.

steps.title: Record the latest interaction
steps.input: Summary of what was sent or discussed in WhatsApp.
steps.output: Updated Last message field on the lead.

steps.title: Update qualification/admission tracking
steps.input: Conversation outcome and any admission/payment information.
steps.output: Updated Status, Lead label, Payment, and Follow-up fields.

entities.name: lead
entities.label: Lead
entities.description: An admissions or course inquiry lead tracked from spreadsheet rows and followed up manually through WhatsApp.

fields.name: course
fields.label: Course
fields.placeholder: e.g. MCT Data Science, JEE Main Course

fields.name: lastMessage
fields.label: Last message
fields.placeholder: Short summary of the latest WhatsApp message

painPoints: Staff switch manually between WhatsApp Web and the admissions spreadsheet.
Lead follow-up timing is stored as free text, which can be easy to miss.
Only the latest message summary is visible in the sheet, so context can be lost.
Status, label, and payment values are manually maintained and may become inconsistent without controlled options.
Messaging is repetitive, but WhatsApp API automation is out of scope for this MVP.

messageTemplates.name: Free WhatsApp consult follow-up
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{leadName}}, following up on your interest in {{course}}. We can do a free consult over WhatsApp. Does {{followUp}} work for you?

messageTemplates.name: Available batches reply
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{leadName}}, thanks for asking about available batches for {{course}}. I can share the current options here on WhatsApp. What timing works best for you?

messageTemplates.name: General admissions follow-up
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{leadName}}, just checking in about your {{course}} admission inquiry. Please reply here when you are available, and I will update your follow-up.

screens.name: Admissions Leads Table
screens.description: Spreadsheet-style table showing Lead name, Phone, Course, Age, Status, Lead label, Payment, Follow-up, and Last message, with CSV export.

screens.name: Add/Edit Lead Form
screens.description: Form for entering or updating the same lead fields shown in the admissions sheet.

screens.name: Lead Detail
screens.description: Single-lead view for reviewing contact details, status, payment, follow-up, and last message before or after WhatsApp contact.

screens.name: WhatsApp Message Templates
screens.description: Copyable templates populated with lead fields for manual paste into WhatsApp Web.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Are Current, Reserved, and Waiting the complete set of admission status values for the MVP?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, use only the values visible in the sheet for now.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should Follow-up remain a free-text field like “Tomorrow 11am” and “Friday 2pm,” or should it become a structured date/time later?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Use free text for MVP because the sheet examples are free text.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Are New Lead, Interested, and Hot Lead the complete lead label options?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, use only the values visible in the sheet for now.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should the MVP store only Last message, rather than a full message history?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, store only Last message because that is what the sheet shows.
